title: A quadratic upper bound on the Chvátal rank of polytopes in the 0/1-cube
summary: We show that every polytope $P\subseteq[0,1]^n$, and more generally every compact convex set, has Chvátal rank at most $12.22n^2+n\log_2 n+2n+4$. This improves the $O(n^2\log n)$ bound of Eisenbrand and Schulz and, together with the $Ω(n^2)$ lower bound of Rothvoß and Sanità, shows that the maximum Chvátal rank of a polytope in $[0,1]^n$ is $Θ(n^2)$.
